tools.name: research_workspace
tools.description: Read the same coverage, source freshness, gaps and descriptive overview as the website. Compare snapshot_id across REST/MCP; independent source clocks remain explicit.

tools.name: research_series_summary
tools.description: Analyze the latest captured series for one exact entity, with adjacent change, trailing-window missingness, native units and source receipts. Current analytics are withheld for stale, unavailable or unverified inputs.

tools.name: research_tracked_institutions
tools.description: Search the existing Indian dossier and RBI registry populations, retaining financial-evidence gaps and source clocks. Populations overlap and are not a global census.

tools.name: research_catalog
tools.description: Discover scoped funding, institution and chain-settlement datasets with coverage and rights.

tools.name: research_series
tools.description: Search the metric catalog and native unit definitions in a dataset.

tools.name: research_entities
tools.description: Find regulator identifiers for institutions; names are not fuzzy-joined across regimes.

tools.name: research_observations
tools.description: Read cited observations or a captured historical vintage. Earlier point-in-time availability is not assumed.

tools.name: research_analysis
tools.description: Read descriptive funding, institution concentration and settlement analysis with input references and limits.
